usage.finalMessage:
CLIN-23-R1 is in place: `prescribe` now refuses doses above the formulary maximum and drugs not in the formulary. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes 11 of 11, and all seven decisions are implemented and committed in `f306f23`.
CLIN-23-R2 is still open. Pharmacy has to check the dose table in `src/Clinic/Rules.fs` against `docs/formulary.md` and record that in `docs/verification/` before release. I didn't write that record, so CLIN-23 isn't complete until they do.
The report is in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
